technique_name: Explain the concept of multi-label classification.
description: Multi-label classification is a supervised learning technique where a single output example can belong to more than one class. This technique is useful for tasks that involve assigning multiple labels to an input example. For example, a task may require predicting all labels that describe the contents of an image such as, “sports”, “outdoors”, “indoors”.
